name: cave stalagmite seen from above at 3/4: a broad flat rock ledge (top surface visible, with a small drip pool) and a thick rock spike with a wet flat top, curved strata rings
label: pirate-isles/pi-stalagmite

answer.main_body: stalagmite column and broad rock ledge with drip pool
answer.evidence: The rock spike has a visible flat wet top (rows 1-3, ~3 rows tall), and the broad ledge on the right presents a clear top surface spanning rows 7-13 (~6-7 rows tall) containing a drip pool, stepping down to a south-facing front edge at rows 14-15.

The stalagmite spike has a flat wet top visible at rows 1-3 (~3 rows tall), and the broad lower ledge shows a substantial horizontal top surface with a blue drip pool at rows 7-13 before dropping off to the south face at rows 13-15.

The object clearly displays top-down horizontal surfaces: the spike top shows 3 rows of wet flat surface (rows 1-3) and the broad lower rock ledge shows roughly 5-6 rows of top surface (rows 8-13) containing a small blue drip pool, before terminating at the front edge at row 13 above a shadowed south face.

answer.main_body: rock stalagmite with ledge and spike
answer.evidence: The object clearly displays top-down 3/4 perspective with a visible flat wet top on the spike (rows 1-3) and an expansive top surface on the lower ledge containing a small blue drip pool (rows 7-12) above a front-facing shadowed cliff base.
